g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they are
Your change: "End each open evening with one clear invitation: the date of a first
practice, what it asks of you, and that no is a fine answer." What would make you stop the
test early? Leave empty if nothing would.
Stop if anyone tells us they felt pushed.
End each open evening with one clear invitation: the date of a first practice, what
it asks of you, and that no is a fine answer.
6 of 30 newcomers come to a first practice within 3 weeks
What exactly is the next action, and when will it happen?
